# SemanticSpikeRepresentation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spike-based encoding scheme that maps high-level semantic concepts (e.g., objects, scenes) into temporal spike patterns. Enables direct mapping between cognitive semantics and neuromorphic computation, supporting TCC's goal of topology-aware cognitive processing.
